name: NumberField
description: Collects numeric values with arrow-key stepping, label scrubbing and optional units.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value as it changes; null when cleared

onValueCommitted.description: Called once the value settles: on blur, Enter, a step or the end of a scrub

min.description: Lowest value; steps and scrubs clamp to it

max.description: Highest value; steps and scrubs clamp to it

unit.description: A unit shown after the figures and read with the value

scrub.description: A short label at the start that scrubs the value when dragged

format.description: Intl.NumberFormat options for the shown value

size.description: Field height on the shared control track: 24, 28, 32 or 40

invalid.description: The danger edge and aria-invalid; say why in a Field.Error

disabled.description: Dims the field and blocks input

readOnly.description: Shows the value without letting it change

required.description: Marks the field required for form validation

when: Quantities, dimensions, percentages and other bounded numbers
Values people nudge more than they type: the arrow keys and the scrub label
A number that carries a unit
whenNot: Codes that look like numbers: postcodes, card numbers, phone numbers (use Input)
Picking a value on a continuous range by eye (use Slider)
Choosing from a short fixed set of numbers (use Select)
guidelines: Wrap in a Field for the label, description and error
Set min and max whenever the value has bounds; steps and scrubs clamp to them
Keep the scrub label to one or two characters: W, H, X, Y
Put the unit in unit, not in the label, so it is read with the value
Use onValueCommitted for work that should wait until the value settles
accessibility: The input keeps the text role with a numeric keyboard and a number role description
Arrow keys step by step, Shift + arrow by largeStep, Home and End jump to min and max
The scrub label is hidden from assistive tech; the keyboard does the same job
The unit is added to the input's description

examples.name: Scrub label
examples.description: Drag the W to scrub; the arrow keys still step.

examples.name: Invalid
examples.description: The danger edge with the reason under the field.
examples.code:
<Field invalid>
  <Field.Label>Seats</Field.Label>
  <NumberField defaultValue={0} min={0} invalid />
  <Field.Error match>Add at least one seat.</Field.Error>
</Field>

relations.note: Field supplies the label, description and error
Use Input for number-like codes that never step
Use Slider to pick a value on a range by eye

propsSummary: step / largeStep: arrow and Shift + arrow increments
unit: shown after the figures and read with the value
scrub: a drag label at the start
